verdict.rationale: Token2 ships tooling and integrations, including CLI utilities and Graph API enrollment scripts, so an interactive API reference is a fair question for it. The evidence shows none: OpenAPI and Swagger probes all returned 404. The in-browser FIDO2/WebAuthn demo and TOTP toolset are interactive tools, not an API reference with runnable examples, so they are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
